proposal.summary: Incorrect permission assignment for critical resource exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3, allowing a user to potentially destroy the system or execute malicious programs.
proposal.affected_product: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3
proposal.cwe_quote: Incorrect permission assignment for critical resource exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3.

AV.quote: ACL (Access Control List) is not appropriately set to the local folder where the affected product is installed, therefore a wide range of privileges is permitted to a user of the PC where the affected product is installed.

PR.quote: a wide range of privileges is permitted to a user of the PC where the affected product is installed.

C.quote: the user may be able to destroy the system and/or execute a malicious program.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate and remediate the ACL settings for the affected product installation directory.

evidence_quotes.claim: CWE-732 - Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
evidence_quotes.quote: Incorrect permission assignment for critical resource exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3.

evidence_quotes.claim: User privileges may allow system destruction or malicious program execution
evidence_quotes.quote: the user may be able to destroy the system and/or execute a malicious program.

ACL (Access Control List) is not appropriately set to the local folder where the affected product is installed, therefore a wide range of privileges is permitted to a user of the PC where the affected product is installed.
